# PUI

> A design system on top of shadcn/ui + Tailwind v4. Slightly green-tinted neutrals and one brand color (deep teal `primary`). UI copy in US English.

## Docs
- [Documentation site](https://aline-aroucha.github.io/pui): tokens, typography, components with live previews
- [Agent rules](AGENTS.md): what to always and never do
- [Full guidelines](docs/guidelines.md)
- [Tokens](tokens/tokens.json): colors (light/dark), typography, spacing, radius, shadow
- [CSS](src/styles/globals.css): tokens as shadcn CSS variables
